context: Written AFTER the development results for S1-S4 were seen (all lost money; no candidate). Adds the standard academic momentum specifications as new strategies. The holdout (2024-10-01..2026-09-30) remains unopened. Trial count for PSR/DSR becomes N = 7.
unchanged: Universe, classification, eligibility (except the listing-age requirement below), dedup, data, periods, holdout guard, execution model (T+1, limits, costs 2.5+10 bp primary and 2.5+20 bp sensitivity, SHIBOR cash), benchmarks, metrics, and the candidate selection conditions.

new_strategies.S5_IND_MOM_12_1: Monthly. Signal at the close of the last session of each month; trades at the next session open. Score = adjusted close 21 sessions before the signal / adjusted close 252 sessions before the signal - 1 (12-1 month momentum, skipping the most recent month). Select top 5 eligible ETFs by score, equal weight 1/5 each (unfilled slots stay cash). No trend filter, no stop-loss.
new_strategies.S6_IND_MOM_6_1: Same as S5 with 126 instead of 252 sessions (6-1 month momentum).
new_strategies.S7_DUAL_MOM_12_1: S5 plus an absolute-momentum filter: a selected ETF is held only if its 12-1 return exceeds the SHIBOR cash return over the same window (product of daily SHIBOR accrual from 252 to 21 sessions before the signal, previous-session rates only); otherwise its 1/5 slot stays cash.

eligibility_change_for_S5_S7: Listing age requirement is at least 253 sessions of bars (needed for the 12-1 score); S6 uses the same 253 so that S5-S7 share one eligible set. All other eligibility and dedup rules unchanged.
scoring_window: S5-S7 are scored on the same DEV, DEV_A, DEV_B windows as S1-S4 (first execution 2020-07-13 or later if the first monthly signal falls later; report the exact start).
selection: Candidate pool becomes S1-S7; same conditions (DEV xSharpe > EW_SECTOR and CSI300_BH; DEV MDD < CSI300_BH; xSharpe > EW_SECTOR in DEV_A and DEV_B; all also under the sensitivity cost). At most 1 candidate, highest min(DEV_A, DEV_B) xSharpe. DSR uses N = 7.
holdout: Unchanged: only after selection, only for a qualifying candidate, only with the user's explicit go-ahead.
